prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Helium (He) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a Roman marble bath hall — columns, mosaic floors and a wide steaming pool lit from high windows
Outfit: your own design — create a revealing, fashionable outfit for this place and moment, as daring as the scene allows: a figure-hugging cut with bare skin by design (neckline, shoulders, midriff or legs), styled with care. New design: before drawing, read our outfit catalog (outfit-catalog.md in this pack — every outfit type we already use) and design one that is NOT in it, then write that outfit into this line; it stays, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands brace on the edge on either side of her hips.
LEGS: feet dipped in the water below the edge.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — the lightest noble gas: aloof and never reacting with anything, yet always lifting — balloons, airships, feet hovering just above the ground; first found not on Earth but in sunlight, as a single golden spectral line at the edge of an eclipsed sun; a gas-discharge tube glowing soft peach-pink; chilled near absolute zero it becomes a superfluid that creeps up the walls of its glass — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
